hook: In 2025/26, 1.8 million workers in Great Britain suffered from work-related ill health.

sections.voiceover: In 2025/26, 1.8 million workers in Great Britain suffered from work-related ill health.
Did you know 0.5 million workers in Great Britain suffered from work-related musculoskeletal disorders in 2025/26?
However, 0.9 million workers in Great Britain suffered from work-related stress, depression, or anxiety.

The Health and Safety Executive Annual Report and Accounts 2025/26 highlights these widespread health challenges. Tragically, 124 workers were killed at work across Great Britain during the 2025/26 period.
Prioritize safety to help reduce these 124 workplace fatalities recorded in Great Britain during 2025/26.
